# infoblox_ipv6_fixed_address (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox Ipv6fixedaddress from both the NIOS and UDDI backends.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific IPv6 Fixed Address by filters
data "infoblox_ipv6_fixed_address" "get_ipv6_fixed_address_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    ipv6addr = "2001:db8:abcd:1231::2"
  }
}

// Retrieve specific IPv6 Fixed Address using Extensible Attributes
data "infoblox_ipv6_fixed_address" "get_ipv6_fixed_address_using_extensible_attributes" {
  ext_attr_filters = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all IPv6 Fixed Addresses
data "infoblox_ipv6_fixed_address" "get_all_ipv6_fixed_address" {}
```

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific IPv6 Fixed Address by filters
data "infoblox_ipv6_fixed_address" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_fixed_address"
  }
}

// Retrieve specific IPv6 Fixed Address using Tags
data "infoblox_ipv6_fixed_address" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    Site = "location-1"
  }
}

// Retrieve all IPv6 Fixed Addresses
data "infoblox_ipv6_fixed_address" "example_all" {}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `ext_attr_filters` (Map of String) Extensible Attribute Filters are used to return a more specific list of results by filtering on extensible attributes. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `limit` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for UDDI backend.
- `max_results` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. Only applicable for UDDI backend.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios`

Read-Only:

- `address_type` (String) The address type value for this IPv6 fixed address. When the address type is "ADDRESS", a value for the 'ipv6addr' member is required. When the address type is "PREFIX", values for 'ipv6prefix' and 'ipv6prefix_bits' are required. When the address type is "BOTH", values for 'ipv6addr', 'ipv6prefix', and 'ipv6prefix_bits' are all required.
- `allow_telnet` (Boolean) This field controls whether the credential is used for both the Telnet and SSH credentials. If set to False, the credential is used only for SSH.
- `cli_credentials` (Attributes List) The CLI credentials for the IPv6 fixed address. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--cli_credentials))
- `comment` (String) Comment for the fixed address; maximum 256 characters.
- `device_description` (String) The description of the device.
- `device_location` (String) The location of the device.
- `device_type` (String) The type of the device.
- `device_vendor` (String) The vendor of the device.
- `disable` (Boolean) Determines whether a fixed address is disabled or not. When this is set to False, the IPv6 fixed address is enabled.
- `disable_discovery` (Boolean) Determines if the discovery for this IPv6 fixed address is disabled or not. False means that the discovery is enabled.
- `domain_name` (String) The domain name for this IPv6 fixed address.
- `domain_name_servers` (List of String) The IPv6 addresses of DNS recursive name servers to which the DHCP client can send name resolution requests. The DHCP server includes this information in the DNS Recursive Name Server option in Advertise, Rebind, Information-Request, and Reply messages.
- `duid` (String) The DUID value for this IPv6 fixed address.
- `dynamic_allocation` (Attributes) Dynamically allocate the ip using the NIOS next_available_ip function call. Mutually exclusive with the static value field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--dynamic_allocation))
- `enable_immediate_discovery` (Boolean) Determines if the discovery for the IPv6 fixed address should be immediately enabled.
- `ext_attrs` (Map of String) Extensible attributes associated with the object. For valid values for extensible attributes, see {extattrs:values}.
- `ext_attrs_all` (Map of String) All ext_attrs including Terraform Internal ID and inherited attributes.
- `ipv6addr` (String) The IPv6 Address of the DHCP IPv6 fixed address.
- `ipv6prefix` (String) The IPv6 Address prefix of the DHCP IPv6 fixed address.
- `ipv6prefix_bits` (Number) Prefix bits of the DHCP IPv6 fixed address.
- `logic_filter_rules` (Attributes List) This field contains the logic filters to be applied to this IPv6 fixed address. This list corresponds to the match rules that are written to the DHCPv6 configuration file. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--logic_filter_rules))
- `mac_address` (String) The MAC address for this IPv6 fixed address.
- `match_client` (String) The match_client value for this fixed address. Valid values are: "DUID": The fixed IP address is leased to the matching DUID. "MAC_ADDRESS": The fixed IP address is leased to the matching MAC address.
- `name` (String) This field contains the name of this IPv6 fixed address.
- `network` (String) The network to which this IPv6 fixed address belongs, in IPv6 Address/CIDR format.
- `network_view` (String) The name of the network view in which this IPv6 fixed address resides.
- `options` (Attributes List) An array of DHCP option dhcpoption structs that lists the DHCP options associated with the object. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--options))
- `preferred_lifetime` (Number) The preferred lifetime value for this DHCP IPv6 fixed address object.
- `reserved_interface` (String) The reference to the reserved interface to which the device belongs.
- `restart_if_needed` (Boolean) Restarts the member service. The restart_if_needed flag can trigger a restart on DHCP services only when it is enabled on CP member.
- `snmp3_credential` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--snmp3_credential))
- `snmp_credential` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--snmp_credential))
- `template` (String) If set on creation, the IPv6 fixed address will be created according to the values specified in the named template.
- `valid_lifetime` (Number) The valid lifetime value for this DHCP IPv6 Fixed Address object.

<a id="nestedatt--results--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.uddi`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The reserved address.
- `comment` (String) The description for the fixed address. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `dhcp_options` (Attributes List) The list of DHCP options. May be either a specific option or a group of options. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--dhcp_options))
- `disable_dhcp` (Boolean) Optional. _true_ to disable object. The fixed address is converted to an exclusion when generating configuration.  Defaults to _false_.
- `hostname` (String) The DHCP host name associated with this fixed address. It is of FQDN type and it defaults to empty.
- `inheritance_parent` (String) The resource identifier.
- `inheritance_sources` (Attributes) The __FixedAddressInheritance__ object specifies how and which fields _FixedAddress_ object inherits from the parent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--uddi--inheritance_sources))
- `ip_space` (String) The resource identifier.
- `match_type` (String) Indicates how to match the client:  * _mac_: match the client MAC address for both IPv4 and IPv6,  * _client_text_ or _client_hex_: match the client identifier for IPv4 only,  * _relay_text_ or _relay_hex_: match the circuit ID or remote ID in the DHCP relay agent option (82) for IPv4 only,  * _duid_: match the DHCP unique identifier, currently match only for IPv6 protocol.
- `match_value` (String) The value to match.
- `name` (String) The name of the fixed address. May contain 1 to 256 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `parent` (String) The resource identifier.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the fixed address in JSON format.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
